>
[Awakened Animal Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=5297) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 24

</column>

---

You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) and [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43). If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

 You also gain the [Additional Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=5114) general feat for Awakened Animal [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8).
name: Awakened Animal Lore
